verses.1: A song of praise for David. I will exalt you, my God, the king. I will bless your name forever and ever.
verses.2: Every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name forever and ever.
verses.3: Great is the LORD and highly praised; his greatness is beyond measure.
verses.4: Generation after generation will speak of your deeds and declare your power.
verses.5: They will speak of the splendor of your glory and recount your wondrous works.
verses.6: They will declare your fearful wonders and speak of your greatness.
verses.7: They will proclaim the abundance of your goodness and sing with joy about your righteousness.
verses.8: The LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and rich in steadfast love.
verses.9: The LORD is good to all, and his mercy is over all his works.
verses.10: All his works will praise him, and his faithful ones will bless him.
verses.11: They will declare the glory of your kingdom and speak of your power.
verses.12: To make known to the children of humankind your power and the splendor of your kingdom.
verses.13: Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, and your dominion endures from generation to generation.
verses.14: The LORD upholds all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.
verses.15: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food in its season.
verses.16: You open your hand and satisfy every living thing with favor.
verses.17: The LORD is righteous in all his ways and holy in all his works.
verses.18: The LORD is near to all who call upon him, to all who call upon him in truth.
verses.19: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him and hear their cry and save them.
verses.20: The LORD protects all who love him, but he will destroy every wicked thing.
verses.21: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, and all flesh will bless his holy name forever and ever.

notes:
Notes
- v. 12: The phrase "לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם" is rendered as "To make known to the children of humankind" to preserve the poetic intent while using natural English.
raw:
[1] A song of praise for David. I will exalt you, my God, the king. I will bless your name forever and ever.

[2] Every day I will bless you, and I will praise your name forever and ever.

[3] Great is the LORD and highly praised; his greatness is beyond measure.

[4] Generation after generation will speak of your deeds and declare your power.

[5] They will speak of the splendor of your glory and recount your wondrous works.

[6] They will declare your fearful wonders and speak of your greatness.

[7] They will proclaim the abundance of your goodness and sing with joy about your righteousness.

[8] The LORD is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and rich in steadfast love.

[9] The LORD is good to all, and his mercy is over all his works.

[10] All his works will praise him, and his faithful ones will bless him.

[11] They will declare the glory of your kingdom and speak of your power.

[12] To make known to the children of humankind your power and the splendor of your kingdom.

[13] Your kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, and your dominion endures from generation to generation.

[14] The LORD upholds all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.

[15] The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food in its season.

[16] You open your hand and satisfy every living thing with favor.

[17] The LORD is righteous in all his ways and holy in all his works.

[18] The LORD is near to all who call upon him, to all who call upon him in truth.

[19] He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him and hear their cry and save them.

[20] The LORD protects all who love him, but he will destroy every wicked thing.

[21] My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD, and all flesh will bless his holy name forever and ever.

---
Notes
- v. 12: The phrase "לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם" is rendered as "To make known to the children of humankind" to preserve the poetic intent while using natural English.
